hero.label: Legacy Modernization & Project Rescue
hero.h1: Fix the app you have. Skip the rewrite.
hero.sub: Your app is slow, outdated or half-finished, and the original developers are gone. We audit it, stabilise it and modernize it step by step, so it keeps running while it improves. For companies in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe and the Gulf.

aside.d: The previous team left, the app isn't launchable and nobody knows what state it's in.
Old Angular, PHP or Laravel versions that block new features and security updates.
Pages time out, releases break things, and every change takes longer than it should.
Unpatched dependencies, weak authentication or no idea what's exposed.
The knowledge left with the last developer, and onboarding anyone new is painful.

faq.q: Should we rewrite the app or modernize it?
faq.a: Usually modernize. A full rewrite is expensive, slow and risky. After the audit we tell you honestly which parts are worth keeping and which should be rebuilt.

faq.q: Can you take over a project another team started?
faq.a: Yes. We regularly take over unfinished or unstable projects, get access to the code and servers, and continue from there.

faq.q: What does the code audit include?
faq.a: Code quality, architecture, security, dependencies, performance and infrastructure, with a written report and a prioritised plan with estimates.

faq.q: Will the app go down during modernization?
faq.a: No. We work in small, tested steps on a staging environment and release changes gradually, so the live app keeps running.

faq.q: Which old technologies do you work with?
faq.a: Older Angular versions, PHP, Laravel, Symfony, WordPress and older Node.js and React codebases, among others.

faq.q: What happens after the app is stable?
faq.a: We can stay on as your maintenance team for updates, fixes and new features, or hand over to your developers with full documentation.
